title: Django Migrations: A Primer
description: Get comfortable with Django migrations: create database tables without writing SQL, and keep your database in step as your models change.
summary: Since version 1.7, Django has come with built-in support for database migrations. In Django , database migrations usually go hand in hand with models: whenever you code up a new model, you also generate a migration to create the necessary table in the database.
takeaways: Instead of defining database tables in SQL, you write Django models in Python.
Here’s an example of how a Django model class is mapped to a database table: But just defining a model class in a Python file does not make a database table magically appear out of nowhere.
Creating the database tables to store your Django models is the job of a database migration.
